kept_ranges.reason: Présenter les trois hypothèses et le coût pour Gemma sans répéter la mécanique du test
Conscience de Helly, consentement et refus de départ
Commande à distance, révolte et promotion publique du produit
Réintégration de Mark et objectif de retrouver Gemma
Chemin vers l’étage expérimental et vie de Gemma dans les pièces
Lien MDR/Gemma, test du berceau et contribution technique de Cobel
Hypothèses de compartiments extensibles et d’évitement de la souffrance
Hypothèse de pérennité Eagan puis choix final de Mark

duration_note: Estimation au débit réel de la première génération, puis fourchette 106–123 mots/minute. Le MP3 régénéré devra être mesuré pour confirmer 2h minimum et 2h30 maximum.
editorial_notes: Le fil reste la technologie réellement montrée, la relation MDR/Gemma, puis trois hypothèses explicitement qualifiées. Les descriptions de Gabby nécessaires à l’hypothèse sont encore autonomes au chapitre 27. La réintégration rappelle elle-même le rôle de Reghabi ; Petey est mentionné comme un antécédent de la série, sans prétendre que son histoire a été racontée ici. Aucun mot nouveau.
removed_topics: Présentation répétée du contrat de travail de Mark
Capacités préservées sans mémoire autobiographique développées séparément
Enseignement de la doctrine de Kier, expertise et départements
Usage de la technologie hors bureau développé avant les théories
Retour mis en scène, Helena à Woe’s Hollow et visites de Dylan
Court chapitre répétitif sur la détresse expérimentale
Quatre paragraphes d’introduction répétant le fonctionnement du berceau

before_last_two_sentences: The research hypothesis appears to be that a separated consciousness can encounter something tied to another consciousness's distress without that distress crossing over.
Gemma's behavior gives the researchers a result they can observe, even though she hasn't been allowed to understand the experiment she's participating in.
after_first_two_sentences: That leaves room for distinct ideas about what the company could do with its research.
A system that keeps expanding the number of separated experiences would have different uses from a treatment intended to spare someone emotional suffering.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord interne cohérent : le résultat expérimental décrit avant la coupe donne bien l’antécédent de « That leaves room ». Les trois hypothèses et l’incertitude commerciale suivent sans promesse retirée.

before_last_two_sentences: Even an apparently calm completion therefore tells us little about what Gemma would agree to if she could consider her whole situation.
Lumon gets a usable experimental result from conditions that prevent its participant from understanding what her response means to the researchers.
after_first_two_sentences: Helly wakes on a conference table with a voice coming through a speaker.
The man speaking knows there's a procedure to follow.
join_reviews.judgment: Retour chronologique compréhensible : après le cas d’ouverture et le coût du test, Helly est nommée et replacée sur la table. Sa scène explique elle-même sa situation.

before_last_two_sentences: Helly can ask, protest, and send a message.
Her outside self can reject that message and send their body back to the elevator for another shift.
after_first_two_sentences: During Helly's severance procedure, a surgical drill reaches through her skull so that an implant can be placed in her brain.
Lumon's arrangement begins with a physical intervention in the person who'll take the elevator to work.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent entre expérience et mécanisme : le refus de sortie est suivi de l’implant qui rend la séparation possible. L’ellipse temporelle est explicite avec « During ... procedure ».

before_last_two_sentences: Lumon has built its working day around that dependence, with elevators, controlled thresholds, and security equipment determining who wakes where.
The machinery reaches into a person's life through something small enough to place inside the brain, while the person carrying it must live through each separation it produces.
after_first_two_sentences: Helly looks at the numbers on her terminal and sees nothing that explains why Mark wants her to be afraid of them.
They're arranged across the screen, available for her to move through and examine.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : après l’implant et les seuils, le terminal donne l’application quotidienne. Helly et Mark sont déjà présents dans les passages gardés.

before_last_two_sentences: Lumon has put an intimate human reaction inside a procedure with bins and measurable completion.
For Mark and his coworkers, that reaction is the part of the work they can actually know how to do.
after_first_two_sentences: Dylan wakes inside a closet with Milchick in front of him.
He's away from the severed floor, in a home he doesn't recognize, and Milchick wants to know what happened to a card he took from Optics and Design.
join_reviews.judgment: Nouvelle scène autonome : Dylan est nommé dans un placard et l’objet recherché est décrit ; la carte d’Optics and Design n’exige pas le chapitre des rivalités départementales supprimé.

before_last_two_sentences: The guests have been shown smiling workers.
Before Lumon can remove her, one of those workers speaks.
after_first_two_sentences: Mark tries to carry a message into Lumon by staring at words under a bright light.
He wants his innie to receive a question about Gemma, using an afterimage that might remain when the elevator changes which memories he can access.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord cohérent : le gala conclut la révélation publique ; Mark et son message ouvrent une enquête distincte sur Gemma. Le chapitre récapitule les informations dont il dispose.

before_last_two_sentences: The procedure has begun to change what reaches him.
It hasn't made either version of Mark disappear, or given him a settled understanding of the life they now have to face together.
after_first_two_sentences: Irving paints the same dark corridor again and again.
At its far end there's an elevator, with a red downward indicator above the doors.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord parallèle cohérent : la réintégration reste une voie vers Gemma ; les peintures d’Irving ouvrent l’autre voie, spatiale. Le nouvel objet et son lieu sont nommés.

before_last_two_sentences: She lives between appointments she can't fully remember, asks a doctor for news she can't independently check, and discovers that an elevator can interrupt her attempt to get home.
Staff can bring her back to her room, where she'll again know whom she's missing.
after_first_two_sentences: Mark's Cold Harbor file has a progress indicator, and Lumon is waiting for it to reach completion before Gemma enters the room with the same name.
For Mark at his desk, finishing means sorting the remaining numbers.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord causal direct : la captivité de Gemma est établie, puis le fichier Cold Harbor relie le travail de Mark à son prochain test. Le petit chapitre sur la peur peut être retiré sans perte de mécanisme.

before_last_two_sentences: Now that earlier work can assist people trying to reach someone Lumon has confined.
The same pages that record Cobel's contribution give her a way to use her knowledge beyond the service Jame accepted from her.
after_first_two_sentences: Gemma enters different rooms on the testing floor, and each room gives Lumon access to a separate version of her.
The woman who spends time with Dr. Mauer doesn't carry every test back into her ordinary awareness there.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord de théorie explicite : l’origine technique de Cobel ferme le dossier des faits ; les pièces de Gemma réintroduisent ensuite la première interprétation possible, avec ses limites.

before_last_two_sentences: In each case, a person is present during the interval another self doesn't have to bear.
Lumon's possible promise of relief would still leave that person inside the room, living through the experience until someone switches them away.
after_first_two_sentences: At the severance gala, Jame Eagan speaks to the woman he believes is his daughter about his coming revolving.
Helly is awake in Helena's place, so she's hearing a family conversation she wasn't meant to enter.
join_reviews.judgment: Raccord de théorie explicite : le coût de l’évitement de la souffrance se conclut ; Jame et le gala sont réintroduits pour la pérennité Eagan. La formulation maintient cette dernière comme hypothèse.
